summary: Impressions Games' Pharaoh is an Egyptian city-builder with a Cleopatra expansion, a preserved classic route, and a modern A New Era remake with changed presentation and mechanics.

entries.title: Pharaoh
entries.definitive_edition: Pharaoh + Cleopatra on GOG for classic completeness

emulation.notes: Native GOG classic route is preferred; legacy Windows compatibility settings may be needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GOG Pharaoh + Cleopatra with exact fix/resolution state documented

primary.why: GOG's Pharaoh + Cleopatra route preserves the original game plus the Queen of the Nile: Cleopatra expansion and is the best current route for classic behavior. Pharaoh: A New Era is a current remake with modern UI/graphics and changed systems, so it should be labeled as a remake comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use Pharaoh + Cleopatra from GOG for the main classic route. Record GOG build, Pharaoh versus Cleopatra campaign, mission, difficulty, resolution/widescreen fix, language, autosave, and whether A New Era was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modern remake with HD art, UI changes, and overhauled systems
secondary.why: It is accessible and complete, but not exact classic behavior.

all_releases.reason: secondary: historical baseline, superseded for current classic access by GOG.

all_releases.platform: Queen of the Nile: Cleopatra expansion
all_releases.fidelity: Expansion campaign/content included in complete classic routes.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for complete classic Pharaoh coverage.

all_releases.fidelity: Current DRM-free classic route including the expansion.
Full remake with modern graphics/UI and altered systems.
all_releases.reason: secondary: accessible remake, not exact original behavior.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The GOG classic route is best for original behavior; A New Era is a remake with changed systems and presentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document widescreen/community fixes separately; do not treat A New Era as an exact replacement.
